newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 362-day bills average accepted yield 5.08 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 362-day bills average accepted yield 5.08 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 362-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 5.08 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority said.
This compares with 12-month HIBOR of 6.09659 percent at 0300 GMT and an average accepted yield of 5.22 percent at the last monthly tender of one-year bills on November 26.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue eased to HK$2.19 billion from the previous HK$3.49 billion.
The average accepted yield of 89-day bills was 4.53 percent, compared with three-month HIBOR of 5.60795 percent and the average accepted yield of 4.62 percent at the tender last week.
Bids for the HK$2 billion issue was HK$5.75 billion against HK$5.13 billion at the previous tender, HKMA said.
The authority also tendered HK$5.0 billion 26-day bills, the roll-over of the first of three special one-month issues to faciliate the implementation of Real-Time Gross Settlement.
The average accepted yield of the bills was 4.31 percent with bids totalling HK$6.81 billion and against one-month HIBOR of 5.51705 percent.
This compared with an average accepted yield of 4.44 percent and bids of HK$11.95 billion for the HK$10 billion one-month issue tendered on December 5. -- HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
